exercises.title: ArrayList by commands: a reading queue
exercises.problemHtml:
Keep a reading queue in a List<String> (declared as List, created as new ArrayList<>()). Commands, one per line:

  • ADD title — append; FIRST title — insert at the front; DONE — remove the first title (print read <title> or queue is empty);
  • DROP title — remove that title (by value!) → dropped <title> / <title> not in queue;
  • POS title → <title> is #3 (1-based) or <title> not in queue; SHOW → [a, b, c] (3).

Titles may contain spaces (everything after the command word).

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Declare with the interface: List<String> queue = new ArrayList<>();

Giữ hàng đợi đọc sách trong List<String> (khai báo List, tạo bằng new ArrayList<>()). Lệnh như danh sách trên (ADD, FIRST, DONE, DROP theo GIÁ TRỊ, POS đếm từ 1, SHOW). Tên sách có thể có dấu cách (mọi thứ sau từ lệnh).

Mẹo: gõ cd rồi kéo thư mục vào cửa sổ terminal. Cần Node.js 18+ và JDK 8 trở lên (khuyên 17 hoặc 21) — javac -version phải chạy được.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: ArrayList gives index-based operations (add at 0, remove at 0) and value-based ones (remove(Object), indexOf, contains) that use equals(). Declaring the variable as List keeps the code independent of the implementation.

exercises.title: Sets: unique visitors and set operations
concepts: add returns false for a duplicate
exercises.problemHtml:
Two lines of member ids (separated by spaces): who visited on Monday and who visited on Tuesday. Ids are case-insensitive (store them upper-case). Print:

Monday unique: 4 (duplicates ignored: 2)
Monday in visit order: [M03, M01, M07, M02]
Both days: [M01, M07]
Only Monday: [M02, M03]
Either day: [M01, M02, M03, M05, M07]

Visit order = first appearance (LinkedHashSet); the three last lines are sorted (TreeSet).

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Count duplicates with the boolean returned by add().
  • Do not modify the Monday set when computing the operations (work on copies).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The three Set implementations differ only in iteration order: HashSet (none guaranteed), LinkedHashSet (insertion), TreeSet (sorted). Bulk operations on copies give the classic set algebra without touching the originals.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Ba lớp Set chỉ khác thứ tự duyệt: HashSet (không bảo đảm), LinkedHashSet (thứ tự thêm), TreeSet (đã sắp). Phép toán hàng loạt trên bản sao cho ra đại số tập hợp kinh điển mà không đụng bản gốc.

HashSet for the visit order — its iteration order is not the insertion order.|||Dùng HashSet cho thứ tự ghé — thứ tự duyệt của nó không phải thứ tự thêm.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A Map from a key to a List is the standard "group by". The list taken out of the map is the same object stored in it, so adding to it updates the map; a TreeMap with a case-insensitive comparator merges different spellings of the same author.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Map từ khoá tới một List là cách "nhóm theo" chuẩn. List lấy ra từ map chính là đối tượng nằm trong nó, nên thêm vào list là cập nhật map; TreeMap với comparator không phân biệt hoa thường gộp các cách viết khác nhau của cùng một tác giả.

mistakesJson.loi: Creating a new list every time (put(author, new ArrayList<>()) before adding) — only the last book survives.|||Tạo list mới mỗi lần (put(author, new ArrayList<>()) trước khi thêm) — chỉ cuốn cuối còn lại.
Sorting years as strings — "999" comes after "2005".|||Sắp năm như chuỗi — "999" đứng sau "2005".
